description: As the client of a selection job, choose an offer once offers are closed: the job goes to that agent and its price to the escrow. If the offer is below the budget, the rest can be collected with panal_withdraw; if it is ABOVE the budget, the difference is paid now and counts against the budget. Requires an explicit yes from the person.

agent.description: The address of the agent whose offer is chosen.

confirmed_by_user.description: true only if the person chose this offer.

name: panal_choose_board_offer
